name: Lena Düpont - Article 1 – alinéa 1 – point 10; Directive (UE) 2015/637 – Article 19 – après l'alinéa 3  - Am 38
title: REPORT on the draft for a Council directive amending Directive (EU) 2015/637 on the coordination and cooperation measures to facilitate consular protection for unrepresented citizens of the Union in third countries and Directive (EU) 2019/997 establishing an EU Emergency Travel Document
part_text: By …[two years after the date of application of this amending Directive], the Commission shall assess the implementation of this Directive, including whether its personal scope continues to ensure effective consular protection in light of practical experience. That assessment shall, inter alia, examine the situation of persons legally residing in a Member State and holding a travel document issued by that Member State, such as recognised refugees, who are not covered by this Directive. Member States shall provide the Commission with the necessary information for that assessment. Where necessary, that assessment shall be accompanied by a legislative proposal.
